title: `metricName` in trigger metadata is removed — the HPA metric name changes

detection.reason: checked on the composite <type>/<key> of every projected trigger; aws-cloudwatch, huawei-cloudeye and azure-monitor are NOT listed: there `metricName` is the cloud metric the scaler queries (required), not the HPA metric name — leave it there (E2 audit 2026-10-27)

quote: **General**: Remove deprecated `metricName` from trigger metadata section (#4899)
remediation: From 2.12 a `metricName` key in trigger metadata is ignored and KEDA names the HPA's external metric itself. On each trigger named, remove the key and update anything that reads the HPA metric by its old custom name (dashboards, alerts on `kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_*` metric labels, scripts). Scaling itself continues. EXCEPTION: on an `azure-monitor` trigger `metricName` is the Azure Monitor metric to query and stays — an azure-monitor row listed here needs no change. Exception: aws-cloudwatch and huawei-cloudeye REQUIRE `metricName` (it names the CloudWatch / Cloud Eye metric to query — the scaler errors `metric name not given` without it) and azure-monitor uses it the same way; leave those alone.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select((.type | IN("azure-monitor","aws-cloudwatch","huawei-cloudeye") | not)) | select(((.metadata // {}) | has("metricName"))) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row sets metricName as an HPA metric name; the three cloud-metric scalers are skipped on purpose

title: Admission webhook rejects a TriggerAuthentication whose `podIdentity.identityId` is set but empty

detection.reason: the projection records that identityId is set, not whether its value is the empty string

quote: identityid of PodIdentity should not be empty. If it's set, identityId has to be different than \"\"
remediation: An explicitly empty `spec.podIdentity.identityId: ""` is rejected by the 2.12 webhook on the next update of the TriggerAuthentication. Remove the key (to use the operator's identity) or set the client ID of the user-assigned identity.
verifyCommand: kubectl get triggerauthentications.keda.sh,clustertriggerauthentications.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.podIdentity.identityId == "") | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row carries an empty identityId
